question: Chirag Shetty who has been awarded with Arjuna Award in 2020 is related to which of the following sports?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Badminton.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **Chirag Shetty is an accomplished professional badminton player from India.**
 
• At the **Asia Team Championships** in **Hyderabad in 2016,** he made his **international debut **and took home the** bronze medal.**
 
• At the** 2018 Commonwealth Game**s, he earned the** Mixed Team Gold Medal** and the** Men's Doubles Silver Medal.**
 
• At the **2022 Commonwealth Games**, he won the** men's doubles gold medal.**
 
• In** 2020, **he received the **Arjuna Award.**
